component.name: Grub Settings
component.summary: A modern and polite GRUB customizer

description.p: Grub Settings is a user-friendly tool to customize your GRUB bootloader. It allows you to change the timeout, default entry, background image, and more.

ul.li: Change default OS and timeout duration
Manage visibility of other operating systems (Windows, etc.)

description.p: Improved authentication dialog and multi-distro support.
